content.text: No minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume restriction exists anywhere in the agreement — compensation is purely time-and-materials for services ordered under SOWs.

input.quote: During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work. Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: This meets the preferred position: there is no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall charge or volume restriction on Clear Capital anywhere in the agreement (searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "take or pay", "volume" and "retainer" return nothing on point). Fees are payable only for Services actually ordered and performed on a task-by-task basis under agreed Statements of Work (§1(a), §3(a)), on a time-and-materials basis. Exposure is further bounded by the termination rights in §6: either party may terminate on fifteen (15) days' notice when no Statement of Work is outstanding, or for uncured material breach, with Contractor paid only for fees incurred through the termination date. Note for the record that individual Statements of Work are outside this document, so any minimum hours or retainer floor proposed in a future SOW should be reviewed under this rule; §1(a) helpfully provides that this Agreement controls over conflicting SOW terms. No redline required.
